clip.title: Clip
clip.transitionHint: Plays at the end of this clip, with a short audio fade. On the last clip, the video fades out to black.
clip.detachedHint: Audio is detached: move or trim audio clips on their own row to make J/L cuts. ⌘B cuts the selected audio clip.

effects.title: Efectos de video
effects.systemCursorHint: Your normal macOS pointer as it moved on screen: no smoothing, blur, bounce or click effect.
effects.connectZoomsDescription: Suaviza regiones de zoom consecutivas convirtiéndolas en un movimiento continuo de cámara.
effects.autoApplyFreshRecordingZooms: Aplicar automáticamente zooms a nuevas grabaciones
effects.autoApplyFreshRecordingZoomsDescription: Sugiere automáticamente zooms de seguimiento del cursor al abrir una nueva grabación.
effects.zoomGeneralDescription: Ajustes globales de movimiento para todas las transiciones de zoom.
effects.zoomInDescription: Controla cómo entra la cámara en una región de zoom.
effects.zoomOutDescription: Controla cómo sale la cámara de una región de zoom.
effects.connectedZoomDescription: Ajusta el deslizamiento entre regiones de zoom consecutivas cuando la conexión está activada.
effects.motionPresetsZoomHint: Zoom motion presets are available in Settings.

focused.label: Focused
focused.description: Snappier motion for demos, walkthroughs, and everyday recordings.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.description: Gentler motion for presentations, keynote-style videos, and polished reveals.

none.label: Off
none.description: No click graphic. Only the cursor motion changes when you click.

ripple.label: Ripple
ripple.description: Expanding rings radiate from each click so taps read clearly in motion.

spotlight.label: Spotlight
spotlight.description: A soft halo flashes around the pointer to emphasize the clicked area.

echo.label: Echo
echo.description: A pair of soft rings that spread outward with a cleaner pulse.

effects.webcamFootageDescription: No hay metraje de cámara vinculado a este video
effects.webcamSyncOffsetHint: + retrasa la cámara, − la adelanta. Úsalo si labios y voz no coinciden.

captions.timelineQuickAdd: Pasar el cursor para añadir en la línea de tiempo

crop.title: Recortar video
crop.instruction: Arrastra cada lado para ajustar el área de recorte

background.title: Fondo

background.uploadErrorDescription: Solo se admiten imágenes JPG y JPEG.

audio.title: Audio
audio.duckingHint: Use this on music: it dips under your voice, in the preview and the export.

voice.importHint: Same length as the exported file. It replaces the voice for every project using this recording.

voice.failed: Something went wrong with the voice track.
